request.input:
Write an employer-facing cover letter tailored to this job. Use only candidate facts from the source. Preserve contribution level, shared results, dates, credential status and academic/project context. Do not turn job requirements into candidate history. Choose the strongest relevant evidence, retain useful concrete detail, and write clear natural professional English. Make a focused case through one or two relevant examples rather than reciting the résumé. Avoid generic praise and invented motivation. Use 2–4 paragraphs, at most 320 words, a salutation and signoff.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Staff Accountant position with Example C02 Services in Hamilton. In my Accounting Assistant role at Example Parts Distribution (2021–2026), I prepared bank reconciliations for six operating accounts and submitted reconciling items to the controller before month-end review. I also matched supplier invoices to purchase orders in QuickBooks and maintained the fixed-asset additions register.

During a 2025 month-end improvement project, I identified duplicate bank-feed entries underlying recurring reconciliation differences. I documented the import steps and tested a revised checklist with the controller. Across the next three monthly reviews, unresolved differences declined from 18 to 5, and the controller approved the final adjustments. This work required investigation, clear documentation, and follow-through on reconciliation issues.

I hold an Accounting diploma from Example Business College and am completing CPA preparatory courses; I do not hold a CPA designation. My experience with bank reconciliations, Excel pivot tables, QuickBooks, and fixed-asset additions records aligns with the responsibilities of this role. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss my application.
